rules: Counts are diagnostics, not a proof of requested-key completeness.
A nonpaged endpoint requires its reviewed nonpagination/universe contract; do not invent terminal pages.
Do not infer legal emptiness or paused status from zero rows or bar presence.
Original R15 receipt fields are reused as a structure, not inherited as acceptance.
Do not infer a current quota or supplier availability from August records.
New dates, lag, historical starts, adjustment basis and PIT timestamps stay unbound until GPT binds the scope.
Separate RAW_NONE price acquisition from adjustment-factor and adjusted-price admission.
